scope: A0 reference-source inventory; no Caligo capability or field acceptance asserted

counting_rules.actions: getAllHandlers explicit new expressions plus value-import-reachable @ActionHandler declarations; duplicate Map keys use last registration.
counting_rules.aliases: Each actual registration inserts base, _async and _rate_limited. Aliases are keys, not independent backend implementations.
counting_rules.tests: Unreachable decorator test classes excluded with reasons; explicitly registered test_download_stream retained in raw denominator and flagged.
counting_rules.events: Class declarations under OneBot/second-protocol event directories; abstract/base classes included and flagged. This is a declaration denominator, not emitted event coverage.
counting_rules.message_segments: OB11MessageDataType enum members; declaration/schema evidence does not establish send/receive support.
counting_rules.exports: Rows of three tracked exports.tsv files; each inherits export_contract_defaults.unreviewed_export. Symbol presence alone says nothing about ABI/behavior equivalence.
counting_rules.other_sections: Manifest, adapter, route, interface and script declarations with distinct section denominators; no claim of exhaustive semantic decomposition of every helper.

unknowns.reason: Lexical role/token mentions are evidence candidates; per-action and per-endpoint access control is not inferred.
Reference code was not executed; static value-import closure does not model bundler tree shaking, dynamic modules or arbitrary side effects.
Schemas are pointed to, never evaluated. Conditional checks, inheritance and referenced definitions need manual review.
Declarations and schema references do not prove event production or direction-specific message handling.
Export lists and TS declarations do not prove ABI, ownership, lifetime, hash-bound host support or hidden/O3 behavior.

Tool denominator covers tracked package scripts and five root launch/deployment tools; research fixtures, vendored tools and arbitrary internal helper methods are not flattened into product capabilities.
All Caligo handler/normal_entry values are null pending separate source/backend review. Empty lists, learned-only group caches and placeholder group_info are not verified backends.
Research contract documents are pointers, not blanket supported-version or field-success claims. Precise module hashes and per-item acceptance remain unassigned.

unknown_reasons: Input/output semantics, authorization, host binding and supported versions require per-item review.
Caligo implementation, backend, normal-entry reachability and acceptance have not been assessed; placeholders are not support.
